title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts
description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts containing sensitive data. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot, including pre-built agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot,  from returning a response when prompts contain sensitive data or using that sensitive data for grounding in Microsoft 365 or the web.
